Difficulty.help: Selects the behavior for “Difficulty”. Default: None.

RandomizerType.help: Selects the Pal spawn randomization mode: disabled, randomized by region, or fully randomized.

RandomizerSeed.help: Sets the seed used by Pal spawn randomization.

bIsRandomizerPalLevelRandom.help: When enabled, wild Pal levels are fully random. When disabled, levels are randomized only within each area's intended range.
bIsRandomizerPalLevelRandom.False: Pal levels stay within each region's intended level range.
bIsRandomizerPalLevelRandom.True: Wild Pal levels are fully randomized.

ExpRate.help: Multiplier for experience gained by players and Pals.

PalSpawnNumRate.help: Multiplier for the number of wild Pals spawned. Higher values can significantly increase server load.

PalDamageRateAttack.help: Multiplier for damage dealt by Pals.

PalDamageRateDefense.help: Multiplier for damage received by Pals.

PlayerDamageRateAttack.help: Multiplier for damage dealt by players.

PlayerDamageRateDefense.help: Multiplier for damage received by players.

PlayerStomachDecreaceRate.help: Multiplier for player hunger depletion. Higher values make players become hungry faster.

PlayerStaminaDecreaceRate.help: Multiplier for player stamina consumption. Higher values drain stamina faster.

PlayerAutoHPRegeneRate.help: Multiplier for natural player health regeneration.

PlayerAutoHpRegeneRateInSleep.help: Multiplier for player health regeneration while sleeping.

PalStomachDecreaceRate.help: Multiplier for Pal hunger depletion. Higher values make Pals become hungry faster.

PalStaminaDecreaceRate.help: Multiplier for Pal stamina consumption. Higher values drain stamina faster.

PalAutoHPRegeneRate.help: Multiplier for natural Pal health regeneration.

PalAutoHpRegeneRateInSleep.help: Multiplier for Pal health regeneration while sleeping or stored in a Palbox.

BuildObjectHpRate.help: Multiplier for building durability. Higher values make structures withstand more damage.

BuildObjectDamageRate.help: Multiplier for damage dealt to buildings. Higher values make structures easier to destroy.

BuildObjectDeteriorationDamageRate.help: Multiplier for natural building deterioration. 0 disables deterioration damage.

CollectionDropRate.help: Multiplier for the amount of resources obtained from gatherable objects.

CollectionObjectHpRate.help: Multiplier for the durability of gatherable objects such as rocks and trees.

CollectionObjectRespawnSpeedRate.help: Multiplier affecting how quickly gatherable objects respawn.

EnemyDropItemRate.help: Multiplier for the quantity of items dropped by enemies.

DeathPenalty.help: Selects what players drop on death: nothing, items, items and equipment, or items, equipment and team Pals.

bEnablePlayerToPlayerDamage.help: Controls whether players can directly damage other players.
bEnablePlayerToPlayerDamage.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bEnablePlayerToPlayerDamage.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bEnableFriendlyFire.help: Controls whether players can damage allied players and friendly targets.
bEnableFriendlyFire.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bEnableFriendlyFire.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bEnableInvaderEnemy.help: Enables or disables enemy raids against bases.
bEnableInvaderEnemy.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bEnableInvaderEnemy.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bActiveUNKO.help: Controls whether Pals produce manure while active in the world.
bActiveUNKO.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bActiveUNKO.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bEnableAimAssistPad.help: Enables or disables aim assistance when using a controller.
bEnableAimAssistPad.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bEnableAimAssistPad.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bEnableAimAssistKeyboard.help: Enables or disables aim assistance when using keyboard and mouse.
bEnableAimAssistKeyboard.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bEnableAimAssistKeyboard.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

DropItemMaxNum.help: Sets the maximum number of dropped item stacks that may exist in the world at once. Excess items may be removed.

DropItemMaxNum_UNKO.help: Sets the maximum number of Pal manure drops that may exist in the world at once.

BaseCampMaxNum.help: Sets the total number of bases that may exist across the entire server.

BaseCampMaxNumInGuild.help: Sets the maximum number of bases a single guild may own. The official maximum is 10. Higher values increase server load.

BaseCampWorkerMaxNum.help: Sets the maximum number of working Pals allowed at each base. The official maximum is 50. Higher values increase server load.

DropItemAliveMaxHours.help: Sets how many real-time hours dropped items remain in the world before they disappear.

bAutoResetGuildNoOnlinePlayers.help: When enabled, structures and base Pals of a guild are deleted after no guild member has logged in for the configured period.
bAutoResetGuildNoOnlinePlayers.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bAutoResetGuildNoOnlinePlayers.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

AutoResetGuildTimeNoOnlinePlayers.help: Sets how long a guild may remain completely offline before automatic cleanup occurs. Ignored when automatic guild cleanup is disabled.

GuildPlayerMaxNum.help: Sets the maximum number of players allowed in one guild.

PalEggDefaultHatchingTime.help: Sets the real-time hours required to hatch a Huge Egg. Other egg sizes scale from this value. 0 makes incubation immediate.

WorkSpeedRate.help: Multiplier for player and Pal work speed. Higher values complete work tasks faster.

AutoSaveSpan.help: Sets the interval, in seconds, between automatic world saves. Very short intervals increase disk activity.

CrossplayPlatforms.help: Selects which platforms are allowed to connect to the server.

LogFormatType.help: Selects whether server logs are written as plain text or JSON.

bIsMultiplay.help: Controls whether the world runs with multiplayer functionality enabled.
bIsMultiplay.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bIsMultiplay.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bIsPvP.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bIsPvP.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bHardcore.help: Enables Hardcore mode. Players cannot respawn normally after death.
bHardcore.False: Normal respawning after death is available.
bHardcore.True: Hardcore is enabled; normal respawning after death is unavailable.

bPalLost.help: Controls whether team Pals are permanently lost when a player dies.
bPalLost.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bPalLost.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bCharacterRecreateInHardcore.help: Controls whether a player may recreate their character after dying in Hardcore mode.
bCharacterRecreateInHardcore.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bCharacterRecreateInHardcore.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bCanPickupOtherGuildDeathPenaltyDrop.help: Controls whether players may collect death-penalty items dropped by members of other guilds.
bCanPickupOtherGuildDeathPenaltyDrop.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bCanPickupOtherGuildDeathPenaltyDrop.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bEnableNonLoginPenalty.help: Controls whether penalties are applied to players or guilds after extended periods without logging in.
bEnableNonLoginPenalty.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bEnableNonLoginPenalty.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bEnableFastTravel.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bEnableFastTravel.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bIsStartLocationSelectByMap.help: Controls whether players may select their starting location on the map.
bIsStartLocationSelectByMap.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bIsStartLocationSelectByMap.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bExistPlayerAfterLogout.help: Controls whether logged-out players remain in the world in a sleeping state at their last location.
bExistPlayerAfterLogout.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bExistPlayerAfterLogout.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bEnableDefenseOtherGuildPlayer.help: Controls whether defensive systems may target or protect against players from other guilds.
bEnableDefenseOtherGuildPlayer.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bEnableDefenseOtherGuildPlayer.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bInvisibleOtherGuildBaseCampAreaFX.help: Controls whether base-area boundary effects are visible.
bInvisibleOtherGuildBaseCampAreaFX.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bInvisibleOtherGuildBaseCampAreaFX.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bBuildAreaLimit.help: Prevents building near protected world objects such as fast-travel points.
bBuildAreaLimit.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bBuildAreaLimit.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

ItemWeightRate.help: Multiplier for item weight. Higher values make carried items heavier.

bShowPlayerList.help: Controls whether the player list is available from the ESC menu.
bShowPlayerList.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bShowPlayerList.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

CoopPlayerMaxNum.help: Sets the maximum number of players allowed in a cooperative session.

ServerPlayerMaxNum.help: Sets the maximum number of players who may be connected to the server.

ServerName.help: Sets the name shown for the server in the server list.

ServerDescription.help: Sets the description shown for the server in the server list.

AdminPassword.help: Password used by players to obtain administrator privileges on the server.

ServerPassword.help: Sets the password players must enter to join the server. Leave empty for no password.

PublicPort.help: Explicitly sets the external public port advertised by a community server. This does not change the listening port.

PublicIP.help: Explicitly sets the external public IP used for a community server.

RCONEnabled.help: Enables or disables remote administration through RCON.
RCONEnabled.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
RCONEnabled.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

RCONPort.help: Sets the network port used by RCON.

RESTAPIEnabled.help: Enables or disables the server REST API.
RESTAPIEnabled.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
RESTAPIEnabled.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

RESTAPIPort.help: Sets the network port on which the REST API listens.

bIsUseBackupSaveData.help: Enables automatic world-save backups. This increases disk activity.
bIsUseBackupSaveData.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bIsUseBackupSaveData.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bUseAuth.help: Controls whether server authentication is required for player connections.
bUseAuth.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bUseAuth.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

EquipmentDurabilityDamageRate.help: Multiplier for equipment durability loss. Higher values make equipment wear out faster.

ItemContainerForceMarkDirtyInterval.help: Sets how often an open container is forcibly re-synchronized with clients, in seconds.

ItemCorruptionMultiplier.help: Multiplier for food and item spoilage speed. Higher values cause faster spoilage.

bEnableFastTravelOnlyBaseCamp.help: Restricts fast travel to travel between bases (Palboxes) only. Great Eagle Statues cannot be used while enabled.
bEnableFastTravelOnlyBaseCamp.False: Fast travel is available between Great Eagle Statues and Palboxes.
bEnableFastTravelOnlyBaseCamp.True: Fast travel is limited to Palboxes; Great Eagle Statues are disabled.

bAllowClientMod.help: Controls whether players with client-side mods enabled may join the server.
bAllowClientMod.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bAllowClientMod.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bIsShowJoinLeftMessage.help: Controls whether dedicated servers show in-game messages when players join or leave.
bIsShowJoinLeftMessage.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bIsShowJoinLeftMessage.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

DenyTechnologyList.help: Disables the selected technologies so players cannot unlock or use them through the technology system.

GuildRejoinCooldownMinutes.help: Sets the waiting time, in minutes, before a player may rejoin a guild.

BlockRespawnTime.help: Sets the cooldown, in seconds, before a player may respawn after death.

RespawnPenaltyDurationThreshold.help: Sets the survival-time threshold, in seconds, used to determine whether the respawn cooldown multiplier applies on the next death.

RespawnPenaltyTimeScale.help: Multiplier applied to the respawn cooldown after the configured survival-time threshold is met.

bDisplayPvPItemNumOnWorldMap_BaseCamp.help: Controls whether the world map shows the number of PvP-exclusive items stored at each base.
bDisplayPvPItemNumOnWorldMap_BaseCamp.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bDisplayPvPItemNumOnWorldMap_BaseCamp.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bDisplayPvPItemNumOnWorldMap_Player.help: Controls whether the world map shows player locations and their number of PvP-exclusive items.
bDisplayPvPItemNumOnWorldMap_Player.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bDisplayPvPItemNumOnWorldMap_Player.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

AdditionalDropItemWhenPlayerKillingInPvP.help: Sets the item ID of the special item dropped when a player is killed in PvP.

AdditionalDropItemNumWhenPlayerKillingIn.help: Sets the quantity of the special item dropped when a player is killed in PvP.

bAdditionalDropItemWhenPlayerKillingInPv.help: Controls whether a special item is dropped when a player is killed while PvP is enabled.
bAdditionalDropItemWhenPlayerKillingInPv.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bAdditionalDropItemWhenPlayerKillingInPv.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bAllowEnhanceStat_Health.help: Controls whether players may spend stat points on Health.
bAllowEnhanceStat_Health.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bAllowEnhanceStat_Health.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bAllowEnhanceStat_Attack.help: Controls whether players may spend stat points on Attack.
bAllowEnhanceStat_Attack.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bAllowEnhanceStat_Attack.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bAllowEnhanceStat_Stamina.help: Controls whether players may spend stat points on Stamina.
bAllowEnhanceStat_Stamina.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bAllowEnhanceStat_Stamina.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bAllowEnhanceStat_Weight.help: Controls whether players may spend stat points on Carry Weight.
bAllowEnhanceStat_Weight.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bAllowEnhanceStat_Weight.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

bAllowEnhanceStat_WorkSpeed.help: Controls whether players may spend stat points on Work Speed.
bAllowEnhanceStat_WorkSpeed.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bAllowEnhanceStat_WorkSpeed.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

PhysicsActiveDropItemMaxNum.help: Sets the maximum number of dropped items that may use physics simulation at the same time.

PlayerDataPalStorageUpdateCheckTickInter.help: Sets how often the server checks for updates to a player's stored Pal data, in seconds.

MonsterFarmActionSpeedRate.help: Multiplier for item production speed from grazing Pals at ranches.

AutoTransferMasterCheckIntervalSeconds.help: Sets how often the server checks whether guild leadership should be transferred automatically, in seconds.

AutoTransferMasterThresholdDays.help: Sets how many days the guild master may remain offline before leadership can be transferred automatically.

MaxGuildsPerFrame.help: Limits how many guilds the server processes in one frame. Lower values spread work across more frames.

bEnableVoiceChat.help: Enables or disables the in-game voice chat.
bEnableVoiceChat.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bEnableVoiceChat.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

VoiceChatMaxVolumeDistance.help: Sets the distance up to which voice-chat audio remains at full volume.

VoiceChatZeroVolumeDistance.help: Sets the distance at which voice-chat audio becomes completely inaudible.

bEnableBuildingPlayerUIdDisplay.help: Controls whether a structure displays the player ID of its creator.
bEnableBuildingPlayerUIdDisplay.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
bEnableBuildingPlayerUIdDisplay.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

BuildingNameDisplayCacheTTLSeconds.help: Sets how long cached building-name display data remains valid, in seconds.

EnablePredatorBossPal.help: Controls whether Predator Boss Pals can appear in the world.
EnablePredatorBossPal.False: Disabled. The described feature is not used.
EnablePredatorBossPal.True: Enabled. The described feature is used.

SupplyDropSpan.help: Sets the interval, in minutes, between meteorite and supply-drop events.

ChatPostLimitPerMinute.help: Sets the maximum number of chat messages a player may send per minute.

MaxBuildingLimitNum.help: Sets the maximum number of structures each player may build. 0 means unlimited.

ServerReplicatePawnCullDistance.help: Sets the distance, in centimeters, at which Pals and other pawns are synchronized to players. Official range: 5000-15000.

bAllowGlobalPalboxExport.help: Controls whether Pals may be saved to the Global Palbox.

bAllowGlobalPalboxImport.help: Controls whether Pals may be loaded from the Global Palbox.
